image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a substrate of small, light-colored gravel and pebbles. The salamander features a glossy black body with vivid, irregular yellow patches and spots covering its head, back, and limbs. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad with visible eyes, and the forelimbs are clearly visible with distinct digits. The tail extends towards the upper right, partially out of frame.

The digits on the right forelimb (viewer's left) appear somewhat fused at the base and lack clear separation between individual toes compared to the left forelimb. This is a common AI struggle with fine extremities.
